_comment: Weekday patterns and their members, mirroring the Wrike work schedules.
Copy to schedules.json and edit. Use this when you would rather not give
the populator a Wrike API token; otherwise run with --source wrike.
workingDays accepts day names, three-letter abbreviations, or ISO numbers
(1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday). List only the days each schedule works;
every other weekday becomes a non-working date. Weekends are never
written, and schedule exclusions (leave, holidays) are out of scope.
scheduleType is optional: a user on both a 'Default' and a 'Custom'
